pictures.name: EPL1-Roman-House
pictures.prompt: The atrium of a wealthy Roman house in the first century AD, a shallow rain pool, painted red and gold walls, bronze lamps. Epictetus, a thin young man of about twenty-five with short dark hair and a short beard, in a coarse undyed tunic, with calm, steady eyes, carries a heavy clay water jar across the marble floor while other servants work quietly. Soft daylight from the open roof, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EPL2-The-Master
pictures.prompt: A rich Roman room with frescoes and a carved couch. His master, a heavy wealthy man in his fifties with a shaved face, in a fine cream tunic and a rich blue mantle with gold rings, leans forward from the couch with a hard, stubborn look, one hand on the ankle of Epictetus, a thin young man of about twenty-five with short dark hair and a short beard, in a coarse undyed tunic, with calm, steady eyes, who sits on the floor, his face completely calm, looking up and speaking quietly. No pain, no injury, nothing violent shown. Warm lamplight, tense stillness. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
